what_this_is: the destination plane's cost against the alternatives, measured before the format is argued rather than after

uint8_palette.why_not: 432 distinct destinations are named and a uint8 palette holds at most 254. A plane whose width depends on the data is also a format that breaks silently when the data changes, so this is not merely unavailable today -- it is the wrong shape for a published format

uint16_plane_renumbered_by_first_appeara.why_this_one_is_free: it changes which integer names a destination and nothing else. The side table is written in the same order either way, so there is no decode cost and no contract change -- if it wins, there is no trade to weigh

random_access_to_the_cheapest_alternativ.what_this_measures: answering ONE cell from the column-major run-length encoding, using cumulative run endpoints built at load and never shipped. Every source cell was probed and compared against the plane, so the zero above is a verified lookup and not an assumption
random_access_to_the_cheapest_alternativ.what_it_refutes: that random access to run-length requires expanding the plane, and that avoiding that needs a second shipped structure. The index is smaller in memory than the plane it replaces

what_the_destination_costs_the_bundle.the_denominator: the total actually shipped, including the plane and the side table. The earlier report divided by the total of a bundle carrying the CHEAPEST encoding instead, and left the side table out of both -- pass 49 finding 9

the_decision_and_why: SHIP THE uint16 PLANE, and not because it is cheapest -- it is not, and not because the alternative cannot do random access -- it can. On the source grid the plane deflates to 38,505 against column-major run-length's 28,027, so the plane costs 10,478 bytes more. Pass 49 finding 9 measured what the access argument had only asserted: cumulative run endpoints, built at load and never shipped, answer any single cell in O(log 28,989) and occupy 173,934 bytes against the expanded plane's 661,004 -- SMALLER, with 0 mismatches over all 330,502 cells. So the honest reason is SIMPLICITY: the plane needs no decode step, no second structure to build and keep in step with the side table, and no code path that can be wrong only at a run boundary. That is an engineering preference bought for a known number of bytes, not a necessity
the_free_option_measured_and_declined: renumbering the ordinals by first appearance saves 314 bytes, 0.8% of the plane. That is noise. It is declined not because it costs anything but because adopting it would add an ordinal-assignment step between the raster and the table for no real gain, and every such step is a place the two can drift apart
what_this_does_not_settle: phone latency, which is unmeasured and on the release prerequisite list. The argument above is about where work belongs rather than how much there is
